title: Exhaust valve for marine engine
abstract:
PURPOSE: To work a metal of heat resistance and oxidation resistance at relatively low temperature to make aging treatment and to contrive high hardness and long life integrating metal of different kinds with a main unit, thereafter performing solution treatment and warm forging further aging treatment.  
     CONSTITUTION: An exhaust valve is constituted by arranging a heat resistant steel material in a main unit and further metal of different kinds rich in wearing resistance and oxidation resistance at high temperature in a seat part. After the metal of different kinds is integrated with the main unit, solution treatment and warm forging are performed further to perform aging treatment. That is, as compared with that the conventional one is formed into a compound structure by finally padding a material of different kind welded, a maximum feature is provided in the point that warm finish forging following the solution treatment is applied after previously forming the compound structure. A composition of the metal of different kinds is left as adequately set, so that very high hardness can be obtained by aging treatment after finishing forging.

title: Method and device for explaining sports game
abstract: The disclosure relates to a method and a device for explaining a sports game. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out character recognition on a video frame of a sports game video, and determining the name of an athlete in the video frame; performing posture recognition on the athlete and determining the action of the athlete; determining corresponding action description information of the athlete according to the action of the athlete; and generating the commentary content corresponding to the sports game video according to the name of the athlete and the action description information. The method and the device can improve the accuracy of the explanation content, avoid the condition of manual misstatement, greatly reduce the error rate and save manpower.

title: 3d hair synthesis using volumetric variational autoencoders
abstract: Devices and methods for single-view 3D hair modeling are disclosed. The method for single-view 3D hair modeling includes training, by a neural network processor, a volumetric autoencoder to encode a plurality of 3D hairstyles into latent features, and to generate an output based on the latent features. The method for single-view 3D hair modeling includes training, by the neural network processor, an embedding network to determine hair coefficients of a single hairstyle from an input image. The method for single-view 3D hair modeling includes receiving, by the neural network processor, the input image. The method for single-view 3D hair modeling includes synthesizing, by the neural network processor, hair strands to generate a single-view 3D model of the single hairstyle based on the volumetric autoencoder, the embedding network, and the input image.

title: Compressing and volumetric reducing treatment of solid waste
abstract:
PURPOSE: To prevent the exposing of compressed bodies to the outside after an embedding disposition and to reduce cost by packing solid waste containing rubber, etc., which internally contain reaction after compression into containers and subjecting the waste to compressing and volumetric reducing in this state then to a heating treatment, thereby forming the stable compressed bodies.  
     CONSTITUTION: The fire retardant or other solid waste is packed into the containers 1 such as drum cans and are compressed by a compressing device 2 to form the compressed bodies 4 which are decreased in volume to a fraction. The compressed bodies 4 are then subjected to the heating treatment by a heater provided with a heating means 5 such as electric heater. The heating temp. is preferably set at the temp. above the softening temp. at which the rubber, etc., in the compressed bodies 4 soften to decrease the internally existing reaction and below the temp. at which the thermal decomposition of the rubber, etc., and the generation of harmful gases such as gaseous chlorine do not arise. Said temp. is preferably about 200W400°C with, for example, rubber. Plural pieces of the compressed bodies 4 from which the internal reaction is removed by the heating treatment in such a manner are packed into a storage container 6 such as drum can and thereafter, a fixing material 7 such as mortar is packed between the outside peripheral face of the compressed bodies 4 and the inside peripheral face of the container 6 by a packing machine 8 and the entire part is solidified. The waste body is thus formed.

abstract: Apparatus for etching a metal surface utilizes a specially shrouded centrifugal throwing wheel to effect a uniform, non-pulsating application of very fine, lightweight, impact blasting media. title: Online sparse prototype tracking method based on twin neural network linear representation model
abstract: The invention discloses an online sparse prototype tracking method based on a twin neural network linear representation model, which comprises the steps of carrying out linear superposition on different pictures based on an image mixing method to obtain a complex background picture; modeling is carried out on an appearance model through online sparse prototype tracking, and a tracked target is sparsely and linearly represented by a prototype composed of orthogonal subspace basis vectors and trivial templates; and outputting an occlusion tracking result based on the observation model and the observation likelihood function. The method has the advantages that different pictures are linearly overlapped through a data augmentation method, a complex background picture with semantic information is generated by using a limited training set, the distinguishing capability of the siamrPN to different objects is enhanced, the problem of background clutter is solved, an online sparse prototype target representation model is combined with the improved siamrPN, the target shielding condition is considered, a robust tracker manufactured by using an observation likelihood function and an updating mechanism is used, the positioning accuracy of a tracked target is improved, and the overall tracking performance is improved.

title: Apparatus and method for image registration based on deep learning
abstract: The present invention relates to an image matching device and a method, and an image matching device according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a visible light image input unit for receiving a visible light (RGB) image; An infrared image input unit for receiving an infrared (IR) image; A feature extractor which extracts an object from a visible light image using a deep learning technique and extracts a background image from an infrared image; And a matching unit matching the extracted object with the background. title: Method for positioning temporary supporting point of large structure base layer deck piece
abstract: The invention discloses a method for positioning a temporary supporting point of a large structure base layer deck piece. The method comprises the following steps of (1) confirming a severely-deformed rectangular region required to be supported temporarily in the deck piece; (2) optionally selecting one point in the confirmed rectangular region and using the point as the one-time temporary supporting point, using position coordinates of the one-time temporary supporting point as design variables, and then adopting a zero-order optimization method to calculate position coordinates of an optimal supporting point in the rectangular region through iteration optimizing; (3) selecting a main beam cross point closest to the position coordinates of the optimal supporting point in the rectangular region and using the cross point as the final temporary supporting point. The method has the advantages that the settling volume of a structure can be remarkably decreased, improvement of the stability of a steel structure is facilitated, the design time is shortened, and the design is scientific and reasonable.

title: Optimizing Benefits Selection in View of both Member Population and Organizational Preferences
abstract: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for optimizing benefits plan options offered by an organization through balancing derived population preferences with organizational preferences by analyzing historical selections made by individuals. Census data dividing members of an organization into census divisions may be applied to machine learning algorithm(s) to derive estimated selection preferences of the members. Using selection preferences, costs of various product offering scenarios and overall member satisfaction estimates of the scenarios may be calculated. Product offering scenarios meeting member preference criteria and organizational budget criteria may be presented for review.

title: Toners for electrostatic-image development
abstract: Toners for electrostatic-image development which are toners produced through emulsion polymerization and aggregation and which have excellent fixability even at a higher temperature while retaining intact other various properties and emit no odor offensive to people; and a process for producing the toners. One of the toners produced through emulsion polymerization and aggregation is characterized by having an odor index in terms of the odor of aliphatic aldehydes as determined by gas chromatography of 300 or lower. title: Submicron lens-free microscopic imaging method and system based on neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a submicron lens-free microscopic imaging method and system based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps: under the condition of coherent illumination, obtaining a hologram corresponding to interference fringes generated by an object to be imaged through a non-transparent microscope; performing phase recovery based on the hologram of the object to be imaged, and acquiring two-dimensional amplitude images of different cross sections of the object to be imaged at a first resolution and two-dimensional phase images of the first resolution; and inputting the two-dimensional amplitude image with the first resolution and the two-dimensional phase image with the first resolution into a trained generation countermeasure network to obtain the two-dimensional amplitude image with the second resolution and the two-dimensional phase image with the second resolution, wherein the second resolution is greater than the first resolution. The invention solves the problem of insufficient resolution of the lens-free microscope by utilizing the neural network, can strengthen the resolution of any cell image, allows the lens-free imaging system to break through the limitation of the pixel size and realizes the submicron resolution.

title: Apparatus and method for sensing touch input
abstract: The present invention relates to a touch sensing device and method. abstract: The invention provides a text message extracting method. title: Automatic Discovery of High-Performance Features for Customer Lifetime Value Optimization via Low-Variance Random Projection
abstract: Techniques for automatic discovery of high-performance features for customer LTV optimization via low-variance random projection are described. In one or more implementations, a random projection matrix is generated that is usable to compress a dataset representing a plurality of features associated with one or more customers. Using a first subset of the plurality of features, a simulator is created to model customer behavior. In addition, a policy is trained to determine which advertisements to present to a new customer based on a second subset of the plurality of features. In implementations, the policy is trained by at least using the random projection matrix to compress the second subset of the plurality of features. Subsequently, a performance of the policy is evaluated using the simulator to determine a level of the performance of the policy. This process is repeated a number of times in order to evaluate several possible candidate transformations and compressions of the dataset, with the goal of autonomously discovering and identifying a new compressed set of high-performing features for use in LTV learning algorithms.

title: Method to accelerate working medium flow in rocket engine channel
abstract: FIELD: electric rocket engines. SUBSTANCE: according to proposed method, acceleration is provided owing to action of electrodynamic Lorentz force in nonhomogeneous gas plasma flow. Plasmoids in gas flow are created by T-layer effect formed at artificially provoking overheat instability in channel with magnetic field cross to flow. For this purpose impulsive high current discharge is provided periodically at inlet section of MHD accelerator channel. T-layer at steady state are stable current layers acting onto gas flow at plasma pistons. MHD-process with T-layers preserves stability at high mass density of flow. This methods improves stability of plasma to development of overheat instability at multiple increase in consumption of working medium. EFFECT: increased thrust of electric rocket engine.

title: Ground environment detection method and apparatus
abstract: A ground environment detection method and apparatus are disclosed, where the method includes: scanning a ground environment by using laser sounding signals having different operating wavelengths, receiving a reflected signal that is reflected back by the ground environment, determining scanning spot information of each scanning spot of the ground environment based on the reflected signal, determining space coordinate information and a laser reflection feature of each scanning spot based on each piece of scanning spot information, partitioning the ground environment into sub-regions having different laser reflection features, and determining a ground environment type of each sub-region. title: Method and automated system for assisting in the prognosis of alzheimer’s disease, and method for training such a system
abstract: The invention relates to a method and an automated system for assisting in the prognosis of the progress of, and for assisting in the diagnosis of, Alzheimer’s disease in patients having mild cognitive impairment, or MCI. The invention also relates to a method for training such a system related to identifying discriminant regions of the brain and using said regions to fine tune the assistance method based on new known cases. The invention uses imaging data (PET or MPET) representing the cerebral activity in a plurality of spatial areas (voxels). The method thus includes an image data standardization process and an analysis of cerebral activity values noted in a selection of voxels forming at least one predetermined discriminant region defined by the coordinates thereof in a spatial reference system. The invention may also include a combination of the imaging results with the results of one or more cognitive tests.

title: Material segmentation in image volumes
abstract: The present approach relates, in some aspects, to a multi-level and a multi-channel frame work for segmentation using model-based or “shallow” classification (i.e. learning processes such as linear regression, clustering, support vector machines, and so forth) followed by deep learning. This framework starts with a very low resolution version of the multi-channel data and constructs an shallow classifier with simple features to generate a coarser level tissue mask that in turn is used to crop patches from the high-resolution volume. The cropped volume is then processed using the trained convolution network to perform a deep learning based segmentation within the slices.

title: Thyroid nodule ultrasonic image denoising method
abstract: The invention discloses a thyroid nodule ultrasonic image denoising method, which comprises the following steps: constructing a database of thyroid nodule ultrasonic images; performing NSST decomposition on the thyroid nodule ultrasonic image, and aiming at the characteristic of speckle noise distribution of the thyroid nodule ultrasonic image, obtaining a corresponding low-frequency component denoising sparse representation model so as to eliminate the speckle noise of the low-frequency component and improve the image contrast; designing a deep learning network training model, and combining the high-frequency component after NSST transformation with the deep learning network training model to more effectively separate speckle noise and image edges; and (4) reconstructing the thyroid nodule ultrasonic image with speckle noise removed by INSST. The invention has the following advantages and effects: based on the combination of multi-scale geometric analysis and deep learning, a corresponding speckle noise suppression model and a frame are established so as to obtain a good thyroid nodule ultrasonic image processing result.

abstract: A method of calculating a most probable path (MPP) comprising: with a classification module, classifying each of a plurality of origin and destination (O/D) trajectories into one of a plurality of periods of time, the classification comprising: changing a data sampling time period of any of the plurality of trajectories within the determined classification periods; with the classification module, detecting any O/D data descriptive of an aperiodic O/D trajectory using context data descriptive of the aperiodic O/D trajectory; and with the classification module, calculating a route trajectory serving as a candidate of the MPP to determine a priority O/D trajectory that matches the context data.

abstract: A system provides task-oriented enhancement of a software application that allows for remote, Web-based, technical support. title: Automatic sketch generation
abstract: An example-based facial sketch system and process that automatically generates a sketch from an input image depicting a person's face. Sketch generation is accomplished by first training the system using example facial images and sketches of the depicted faces drawn with a particular style by a sketch artist. The trained system is then used to automatically generate a facial sketch that simulates the artist's style from an input image depicting a person's face. Nonparametric sampling and a flexible sketch model are employed to capture the complex statistical characteristics between an image and its sketch.

title: Efficient prediction
abstract: Disclosed are a system and method for constructing and using a predictive model to generate a prediction signal, also referred to as a classification signal when the signal indicates one of a plurality of distinct classes. In various embodiments, the disclosed technique reduces a size of a predictive Support Vector Model by extracting certain values beforehand and storing only weighting values. The technique does not sacrifice generalization performance but does significantly reduce the model size and accelerate prediction performance. The described system applies to most kernel functions, whether linear or nonlinear.

title: Slip frequency control system
abstract: PURPOSE:To contrive energy saving, by providing a slip frequency correction part correcting the output command value from a slip frequency control means. CONSTITUTION:In a slip frequency correction circuit 6, a D/A converter 6a reads a current command I* in analog value and converts the current command I* into a digital signal and transfers the digital signal to a microcomputer 6b. In the microcomputer 6b, after adding the slip frequency correction value f's to a minor deviation portion DELTAf's for every sampling of the current command I*, a new f's is formed and the new f's is delivered to an inverter through an A/D converter 6c. Therefore, the f's successively moves in a fixed direction every sampling for the command I*.

title: Light-based three-dimensional face optimization method and apparatus, and electronic device
abstract: A light-based three-dimensional face optimization method and apparatus, and an electronic device. title: Deep quality enhancement of adaptive downscaled coding for image compression
abstract: Techniques are disclosed for coding image data adaptively at different levels of downscaling. Such techniques may involve partitioning input data into pixel blocks for coding and performing content analysis on the pixel blocks. The pixel blocks may be input to block coders that operate at different pixel block sizes, which may code the pixel blocks input to them at their respective sizes. Except when a block coder operates at the partitioning size, block coders that operate at different pixel block sizes may perform downscaling of the pixel blocks to match their size with the block coders' respective coding size. A block decoder may invert the coding operations performed by the block coders, decoding coded image data at respective pixel block sizes, then upscaling decoded image data obtained therefrom to a common pixel block size. Image reconstruction may synthesize a resultant image from the decode pixel block data output by the decoders. Quality enhancements may be added by neural network processing systems that have been trained to other segmented images.

title: N-ary tree for mapping a virtual memory space
abstract: A page table is a data structure used by a virtual memory system in a computer system to store the mapping between virtual addresses and physical addresses. Embodiments herein use a tree to map a virtual memory address space in the page table. The tree may be an N-ary tree where N is a power of two (e.g., 2, 4, 8, 16, etc.). The tree may include multiple levels that each correspond to a different page table size. For example, an octree includes eight different entries for each child node which may include per-thread sub-entries. Child nodes in the first level of the octree may each correspond to a 512 GiB page, while child nodes in the second level, however, may each have eight entries that correspond to a 64 GiB page. In this manner, an N-ary tree may be used to support a computing system with varying page sizes.

title: Registering device of standard pattern
abstract: PURPOSE:To improve the speed of character recognition and the precision of character recognition considerably, by registering additionally standard patterns of characters and symbols which are not prepared in a character recognizing device. CONSTITUTION:A picture input device 80 converts a picture on a form to an electric signal to quantize it to a binary. The signal of the picture obtained by the device 80 is stored in a picture storage device 81. A timing mark detector 82  detects the position of a timing mark on a basis of the picture signal stored in  this device 81. A character frame segmentting device 83 calculates the position of a character frame by the position of this timing mark and takes in the picture signal in this calculated position from the device 80. An entry character  frame detector 84 counts the number of black points in the picture signal segmented by the device 83; and if this number is larger than a certain value, it is  discriminated that a picture is written in the character frame. A standard pattern storage device 85 stores features of the signal in the character frame as a standard pattern. A code storage device 86 determines a code corresponding to  the standard pattern on a basis of the position of the character frame and stores  it.

title: Identifying text for labeling utilizing topic modeling-based text clustering
abstract: Software that selects portions of unlabeled text for labeling, by performing the following operations: (i) receiving a set of unlabeled input text for classification with respect to a particular domain, wherein the domain includes a labeled corpus for which topics of a set of topics correspond to labels from the corpus, and wherein the topics include statistical probability distributions of words in the corpus; (ii) performing topic modeling on the input text to associate portions of the input text with respective classifications, wherein the classifications include statistical probability distributions of topics of the set of topics in the respective portions of the input text; and (iii) applying a machine learning-based selection strategy to the portions of the input text and their respective classifications to identify one or more portions of the input text for labeling.

title: Connector mounting means
abstract: The utility model relates to a fixing device for a connector. The bottom of the back end of an insulating base body and two sides of the insulating base body are forwards extended and formed with containing sheets and protecting sheets spaced with the base body, and after the insulating base body is assembled in a metallic shielding element, the bottom seams and two sides of the metallic shielding element can be clamped by the containing sheets and the protecting sheets in order to reinforce the structure of the connector. In addition, the circumference of a splicing end opening of the metallic shielding element can be folded with fixed sheets having screw holes toward lower part to two sides in order to locking screws and fix the connector which is welded on the machine shell for reinforcing the assembled structure of the connector.

title: Multi-stage hotword detection
abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for multi-stage hotword detection are disclosed. In one aspect, a method includes the actions of receiving, by a second stage hotword detector of a multi-stage hotword detection system that includes at least a first stage hotword detector and the second stage hotword detector, audio data that corresponds to an initial portion of an utterance. The actions further include determining a likelihood that the initial portion of the utterance includes a hotword. The actions further include determining that the likelihood that the initial portion of the utterance includes the hotword satisfies a threshold. The actions further include, in response to determining that the likelihood satisfies the threshold, transmitting a request for the first stage hotword detector to cease providing additional audio data that corresponds to one or more subsequent portions of the utterance.

title: Target variable distribution-based acceptance of machine learning test data sets
abstract: Respective statistical distributions of a target variable within a proposed training data set and a proposed test data set for a machine learning model are obtained. title: Defect detection method and device and electronic equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a defect detection method, a defect detection device and electronic equipment, wherein the defect detection method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be detected; inputting an image to be detected into a pre-trained main depth learning network to obtain a detection result graph of the image to be detected; the main deep learning network is obtained based on calibration sample training; the calibration sample comprises a calibration sample obtained by calibrating an uncalibrated sample according to the sample probability obtained by inputting the uncalibrated sample into a pre-trained auxiliary deep learning network; the auxiliary deep learning network is obtained based on the test performance training fed back by the main deep learning network; and carrying out post-processing on the detection result image, and determining the defect area and the defect type in the image to be detected. By the scheme, the accuracy of defect detection can be improved.

title: Method for acquiring performance index configuration data of slave network element and equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a method for acquiring performance index configuration data of a slave network element and equipment, belonging to the field of communication. The method comprises the following steps of: acquiring an installation packet of performance plugins released by the slave network element by first equipment when a new slave network element is added into a network framework or the slave network element in the network framework is upgraded, wherein the installation packet comprises a first plugin and a second plugin, the first plugin comprises the performance index configuration data, required to be stored in the first equipment, of the slave network element, and the second plugin comprises the performance index configuration data required to be stored in second equipment; acquiring the first plugin and the second plugin from the installation packet, and installing the first plugin to acquire the performance index configuration data of the slave network element; sending a first synchronous request message to the second equipment, wherein the first synchronous request message carries the second plugin; and installing the second plugin by the second equipment to acquire the performance index configuration data of the slave network element. By the method, frequent upgrading and service interrupt of the first equipment and the second equipment can be avoided.
